scheme.implementing_agency: State/UT Governments, District Administration, Gram Panchayats/ULBs
scheme.description: Launched 15 August 1995. Five components: IGNOAPS (old age pension: Rs 200/month for 60-79, Rs 500/month for 80+), IGNWPS (widow pension: Rs 300/month, Rs 500/month after 80), IGNDPS (disability pension: Rs 300/month, Rs 500/month after 80), NFBS (Rs 20,000 one-time on breadwinner death aged 18-59 in BPL), Annapurna (10 kg food grains/month for eligible elderly not receiving IGNOAPS). Social audit required every 6 months; 100% beneficiary verification.
scheme.voice_summary: The National Social Assistance Programme gives pensions to poor elderly people, widows and disabled people, and one-time help to a poor family that loses its main earner.
application_process: offline: Obtain the physical NSAP application form from the local Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), or Urban Local Body (Municipality/Corporation).
offline: Fill out the applicant details and attach self-attested copies of Aadhaar, Age Certificate, BPL Proof, and Bank Passbook.
offline: Submit the completed application form to the designated Social Welfare Officer / BDO office.
offline: Undergo field verification conducted by the Gram Panchayat or designated local verification officer.
offline: Upon verification and sanction, receive monthly pension directly disbursed to the linked bank/post office account via DBT.
online: Visit the official NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or state social welfare department portal.
online: Navigate to 'Apply Online' and choose the relevant pension component (IGNOAPS / IGNWPS / IGNDPS).
online: Enter Aadhaar number and complete e-KYC authentication.
online: Upload scanned copies of Age Proof, BPL ration card, and bank account passbook details.
online: Submit the application and note down the generated Application Reference Number for tracking.

procedure_steps.text: Obtain the physical NSAP application form from the local Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), or Urban Local Body (Municipality/Corporation).
Fill out the applicant details and attach self-attested copies of Aadhaar, Age Certificate, BPL Proof, and Bank Passbook.
Submit the completed application form to the designated Social Welfare Officer / BDO office.
Undergo field verification conducted by the Gram Panchayat or designated local verification officer.
Upon verification and sanction, receive monthly pension directly disbursed to the linked bank/post office account via DBT.
Visit the official NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or state social welfare department portal.
Navigate to 'Apply Online' and choose the relevant pension component (IGNOAPS / IGNWPS / IGNDPS).
Enter Aadhaar number and complete e-KYC authentication.
Upload scanned copies of Age Proof, BPL ration card, and bank account passbook details.
Submit the application and note down the generated Application Reference Number for tracking.

procedure_meta.processing_time: 30-45 working days from submission to sanction
procedure_meta.fees: Free of cost / No application fee
